proves: A call of the cancel function that a deadline API returned is suppressed with the rule timing, deferred or not, when every assignment to its variable assigns such a function. The call of a cancel function of a context without a deadline keeps its mutants, and so does the call of a variable that one assignment gives such a function and another assignment does not.
fixture: bounded cancels a context with a deadline before it returns it, and later does the same when its argument is true. stopped cancels a context without a deadline. ended cancels a context that has a deadline when its argument is true, and none otherwise. One test per function checks the context that the function returns.
